Episode 153. The Purpose of Kinzello (1)
"Ha, haha! Wh, what are you talking about? The Bemonte royal family found the body of the first head of Run Kandel?"
Mariella asked, rolling her eyes.
"Don't pretend you don't know. You guys definitely knew that information."
"Hmm, on what grounds do you say that?"
In the past, Mariella had come to the Garden of Swords with Belract to tell Jin that the royal family was searching for the tomb of Temarl.
At that time, Mariella said that if Jin joined Kinzello, she would tell him why they were looking for Temarl's tomb.
Of course, Jin flatly refused, and afterwards, without the help of Kinzello, he found out the royal family's purpose, and even the fact that they already had some parts of Temarl's body.
"Intuition."
At Jin's concise answer, the expressions of the Kinzello executives crumpled.
"I've always thought of Jin as a very logical, cool, and wonderful person. Just like our brother. But intuition, that's not a word that suits Jin, is it?"
"Miss Mariella, that demon has always been like that. Don't you know how much trouble this Bubar has gone through because of his temper?"
"So, you're the Jin Run Kandel that our friend Bubar talked so badly about. I'm Ainas Caligo! I'm a princess of Caligo who loves sweet potato croquettes! I challenge you! How many can you eat?"
"What?"
"How many can you eat at once, sweet potato croquettes. You can probably eat about five. I can eat as many as five hundred... hehehe! I'll slaughter them."
"St, stop, Ainas..."
"Listen carefully, you lowly human. If my sister hadn't stopped me, you would be dead!"
Suddenly, Jin remembered that Amella could have been part of that group of fools. The thought that Amella would fit in well with them gave him a headache for some reason.
"There seem to be more interesting friends than before."
At Jin's sarcastic reply, Bishukel's face was so flushed that it seemed like it would explode.

"And did you say that intuition is not like me to use as a basis? I think you misunderstood what I said. Whether my basis is intuition or something else is not important. What's important is, if you guys don't spit out information about the royal family, you won't be able to look at the things I brought."
"Ha! That, that, he's making an unreasonable demand again! How would we know how they obtained Temarl's body!?"

"If you don't know, you should find out, Bubar. I think, among Kinzello, you're the one who wants to analyze the blueprints and machinery the most. And we don't want to waste each other's time, so if you really don't know, it would be great if you could tell me quickly. Then I'll go back right away."
Jin said this, taking out the mechanical device and blueprints from his pocket and shaking them in front of the Kinzello executives.
'Murakan often said that his lord can be extremely nasty, probably referring to situations like this...'
'That guy, both in the cabin and now. He seems to have a thing for roasting people.'
His colleagues thought this as they saw Jin smiling brightly. The executives of Kinzello barely suppressed their boiling rage.
"Jephrin? It seems like you or Mariella are the leaders, excluding the commander."
"Our vice commander is Bishukel Evriano."
Belract said, distorting his face. After Jephrin arrived, he felt a slight crisis about his position.
"Is that so? Whoever the leader is, make a decision quickly. Haven't you heard that time is gold?"
"Wow, today's Jin is somewhat antagonistic."
"I don't need your favoritism."
"Is that so? Have you forgotten that I and our kind family helped you?"
"I've forgotten all that, but I remember everything you guys did to the Holy Kingdom and Sword Emperor Castle..."
Mariella's eyes were smiling, but she was gritting her teeth. After a moment of hesitation, she decided to accept Jin's offer.
"Jin. First of all, we really don't know how they got the body of the first head of Run Kandel."
"Then I'll leave."
"However, we do know what part of Temarl's body they own. If I tell you this, will you share information about the items?"
"Go ahead and tell me."

"Damn, there's no such bullying as this. Miss Mariella, do we have any more reason to listen? Jin, I don't know why you're acting this way again. This is the land of Kinzello. If we have a little ill-will, annihilating you guys is not a big deal..."
"Of course, I have something to believe in. Mote!"
[Boooong!]
When Jin shouted, Mote and Sirius, who had been hiding nearby, revealed themselves. Initially, Jin and his colleagues had found the land of the beastmen by riding Mote.
"Thank you, Sirius. And Mote. Did you think I came here without any safety measures, Jephrin?"
"Tsk."
"And this is just a safety measure. You can annihilate us if you want to? Your bluff is excessive."
Jin began to show his energy while suppressing his laughter. Then, a vibration occurred around the area, and the dark cloud spread in all directions.
The enemy tribe and the white tiger tribe warriors who were patrolling or waiting nearby in the market fell flat at that energy.
'He has grown...'
Of course, Belract was not at all intimidated by the energy of the Myungwang tribe that Jin emitted, but he was shocked to see that Jin had a different level of energy than his own memory.
His growth rate was too fast. He was just barely twenty years old, but Jin was emanating energy close to level 10.

'Even the flow of energy is not normal. There's also the energy of chaos mixed in, and he could become explosively stronger again at any moment. Did he surpass his limits in the Sword Emperor Castle.'
Jin glared at Jephrin.

"Moreover, you're in a situation where you can't use your power properly. That's why you were only beaten by Talarris in Tikhan last time. Looking at the commander not coming out now, he can't use his power either. Am I wrong?"
"Ah! Jephrin, you were right... Ugh."
"Then what about the lump on the jaw of the grand duke! Ah!"
Bishukel covered the mouth of Bubar, and Bianca covered the mouth of Ainas.
"So if you want to fight, I'll gladly accept."
"You're too arrogant, Jin... How do you plan to handle the aftermath later?"

"And you seem to have forgotten, but the land of the beastmen is very close to the Jean Kingdom. The Jean Kingdom is within the sphere of influence of Run Kandel. So if a fight breaks out here, we just have to hold out until reinforcements from the family arrive. It seems that Lord Stael has some connections with you guys."
Just after using the commander's power again, they really couldn't fight. In the end, Jephrin had to leave as always.
"Now you guys seem to understand the situation a bit. Let's hear the details, Mariella."
"The part of Temarl's body owned by the royal family is the arm."
With Valeria's record magic, they could only know that 'part' of Temarl's body was used. Hearing the direct term 'arm' instead of such ambiguous expression, Jin felt a lump in his chest.
It meant that even in death, his body was torn apart and used in various places.
"Arm?"
"Yes, the left arm. As you may already know, the royal family is trying to complete the Mine magic through it."
"How did you know they have the left arm?"
"Because we had a deal with the royal family."
In reality, they found out through the commander's ability. Jin didn't particularly point that out.
"As far as we know, the body of Temarl Run Kandel was no different from a collection of information on the ancient magic. Due to the deal gone wrong, we didn't have a chance to analyze it properly."
"Thermar's body being a collection of information about ancient magic was also expected by Valeria.
"You won't nitpick this too, saying how could I believe this, would you?"
At Zephyrin's words, Jin nodded.
"I'm not a person who's completely devoid of faith."
"How did you, Lord Jin, find out that the royal family possesses the body of Thermar? You didn't seem to have tortured the emperor... Is it because the record magician is with you?"
Jin didn't answer, instead putting the things he had taken out back into his pocket.
"Huh? Why are you putting it back? Don't think about running away now that you've heard our information. If so, it really won't end with words. Regardless of the damage we suffer."

"Oh, I just put it back because it's uncomfortable to hold, don't misunderstand. The window of conversation is still open. Originally, I was planning to show you after hearing information about Thermar's body, but an extra crime has just been added. Hearing such talk about annihilating us, it doesn't feel good, does it?"
"Hey, one of the 12 Knights of Runecandel, calm down. I can't stand it anymore."
Beract, pulling out the great sword he had on his back, said. Marjiella grabbed his arm and smiled.

"It's okay, Uncle Beract. Let's listen to the story. It seems like today is the day when Lord Jin has a lot of questions for us. And Lord Jin, I hope you remember my appearance today. This pitiful effort to resolve things through conversation."
"I'll try. Okay, final question. Kinzlo, what's your purpose?"

In his previous life, Jin had never been curious about Kinzlo's purpose. He just considered them a third-rate terrorist group that started to stir a bit of trouble worldwide shortly before his own death.
But the current Kinzlo is different.
'Exactly, they had this power back then too, but they just hid it. So many things have changed due to my regression.'
Marjiella and Jin's eyes met.
"As far as I know, you guys have the goal of crowning your king as the only king in the world. But I think that's not all."
"That's all."
"Making your leader the only king in the world is everything. So world conquest, is that the goal?"
At that, Marjiella replied with a laugh.
"Haven't I told you before? We just want to create a better world. So instead of the word conquest, I think purification would be a better fit."
